3636.title: Instruction delivery after ACP resume
3636.rootCauseOneLine: ACP reconstruction re-arms pending instructions before loading the same provider session; personal workspace creation preserves data-directory ancestry.
3636.proposedFix: Define conversation-level instruction delivery/update semantics and a workspace-location policy before implementation.
3636.caveats: Native CLI rediscovery, actual token accumulation, compaction and other rebuild triggers were not exercised.
